verdict.rationale: Synthesia markets a built-in "AI Assistant" that turns a prompt, link, or file into a polished video, so users can delegate video creation to it in-product. The evidence is limited to homepage one-liners and covers only end-to-end video generation; broader delegation is not shown. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's scope beyond prompt-to-video (e.g., editing, revisions, multi-step tasks), detail on how users interact with it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
